mourning_matriarch.description: A veiled orchard spirit rising from a rootbound coffin, crowned with pale fruit and funeral boughs. Her relentless procession rewards slowing attacks and focused fire.
mourning_matriarch.name: The Mourning Matriarch
mourning_matriarch.weakness: Slowing attacks extend the time available for focused fire

ruined_king.description: The fallen sovereign of Castle Ruin, enthroned in shattered masonry beneath a broken crown. Slow and immensely durable, his stone body resists knockback.
ruined_king.name: The Ruined King
ruined_king.weakness: Sustained heavy damage breaks his stone body

basic.description: A moss-draped wanderer with a cracked bone mask, drawn from the Forest's tangled roots. Its steady march gives new towers time to strike.
basic.name: Moss Hollow

bell_hulk.description: A sunken bronze bell carried by a hulking drowned body. Heavy chains and a sealed bell casing resist knockback.
bell_hulk.name: Bell Hulk

blood_acolyte.description: A crimson-robed worshipper carrying a crescent staff. The Bloodmoon Sanctuary restores its wounds throughout its journey.
blood_acolyte.name: Blood Acolyte

briarling.description: A bone-faced thornling that darts from the Mourning Orchard’s portals. Fast attacks and slowing needles catch its fragile wooden frame.
briarling.name: Briarling

cinder_imp.description: A small horned coal creature with a glowing furnace belly. The first inhabitant to emerge from an Ashen Forge portal.
cinder_imp.name: Cinder Imp

coffinbound.description: A walking coffin lashed shut with pale roots. Only the Orchard portal releases it. Slow, durable, and resistant to knockback; heavy damage breaks its shell.
coffinbound.name: Coffinbound

crescent_wisp.description: A floating crescent shrine with a veiled red eye and long prayer ribbons. Its slight form moves quickly beneath the blood moon.
crescent_wisp.name: Crescent Wisp

drowned_thrall.description: A waterlogged pilgrim tangled in reeds and burial cloth. Drowned Crypt portals send it down the roads with a restless current at its back.
drowned_thrall.name: Drowned Thrall

fast.description: A leaf-crowned woodland spirit trailing thorn tendrils. This fragile Forest foe races along the roads toward the core.
fast.name: Bramble Wraith

heavy.description: An ancient woodland husk wrapped in bark and heavy roots. Its slow, sturdy frame resists knockback and rewards heavy damage.
heavy.name: Rootbound Revenant

lantern.description: A soot-robed furnace tender carrying a stolen ember. Ashen Forge portals harden its frame for a steady march through tower fire.
lantern.name: Ember Keeper

mire_wraith.description: A thin, streaming ghost wearing a shell mask. Its trailing fins and torn shroud cut swiftly through the Drowned Crypt's mist.
mire_wraith.name: Mire Wraith

ruin_knight.description: An oathbound guardian in crescent-crowned armor. Bloodmoon Sanctuary portals summon this enduring knight beneath a crimson mantle.
ruin_knight.name: Eclipse Knight

sentinel.description: A dark iron guardian summoned only by castle ruin portals. A deep health pool guards a rich bounty.
sentinel.name: Crypt Sentinel

sepulcher.description: A walking royal tomb crowned with ruined battlements. Castle ruin portals alone release this slow, immensely durable foe, whose stone bulk resists knockback.
sepulcher.name: Sepulcher Colossus

shade.description: A swift shadow born only in castle ruin portals. Its dense shroud withstands sustained fire.
shade.name: Abyss Shade

slag_golem.description: A lumbering pile of blackened iron with an anvil-shaped head and molten seams. Its weight resists knockback.
slag_golem.name: Slag Golem

veil_widow.description: A mourning spirit in a split burial veil, born only through the Orchard portal. Its steady pace and dense shroud reward sustained fire.
veil_widow.name: Veil Widow

caltrop_keep.description: Deploys single-use caltrops on nearby roads. Stores up to {trap_capacity}; each arms in {trap_arm_time} seconds and expires after {trap_duration} seconds. Traps never block movement.
caltrop_keep.name: Caltrop Keep

caltrop_keep:2.description: Deploys single-use caltrops on nearby roads. Stores up to {trap_capacity}; each arms in {trap_arm_time} seconds and expires after {trap_duration} seconds. Traps never block movement.
caltrop_keep:2.name: Caltrop Keep

caltrop_keep:3.description: Deploys single-use caltrops on nearby roads. Stores up to {trap_capacity}; each arms in {trap_arm_time} seconds and expires after {trap_duration} seconds. Traps never block movement.
caltrop_keep:3.name: Caltrop Keep

caltrop_keep:dreadjaw.description: Stores {trap_capacity} heavy jaw traps. Each deals {damage} damage to one victim, arms in {trap_arm_time} seconds, and expires after {trap_duration} seconds.
caltrop_keep:dreadjaw.name: Dreadjaw

caltrop_keep:scatterworks.description: Deploys {trap_count} weaker caltrops per cycle at separate road positions. Stores up to {trap_capacity}; each damages one victim and disappears.
caltrop_keep:scatterworks.name: Scatterworks

electric.description: Forked lightning zaps up to {targets} enemies at a time within reach, of any troop type.
electric.name: Stormspire

electric:2.description: Forked lightning zaps up to {targets} enemies at a time within reach, of any troop type.
electric:2.name: Stormspire

electric:3.description: Forked lightning zaps up to {targets} enemies at a time within reach, of any troop type.
electric:3.name: Stormspire

electric:tempest_web.description: Strikes up to {targets} enemies. Each strike arcs to one additional, distinct enemy within {arc_range} units for {arc_percent}% damage, reaching beyond normal range.
electric:tempest_web.name: Tempest Web

electric:thunderseal.description: After {seal_hits} hits from this tower, a seal detonates for {seal_damage} times hit damage as a bonus and a {stun_duration}-second stun. Charges reset; {stun_immunity}-second stun immunity prevents continuous lockdown.
electric:thunderseal.name: Thunderseal

heavy.description: Large magic orbs reach distant foes and deal heavy damage to resilient enemies.
heavy.name: Obelisk

heavy:2.description: Large magic orbs reach distant foes and deal heavy damage to resilient enemies.
heavy:2.name: Obelisk

heavy:3.description: Large magic orbs reach distant foes and deal heavy damage to resilient enemies.
heavy:3.name: Obelisk

heavy:doomstone.description: Consecutive hits on one enemy increase this tower's damage by {curse_percent}% per curse stack, up to {curse_max_percent}% bonus. Switching targets resets the curse.
heavy:doomstone.name: Doomstone

heavy:grave_echo.description: A heavy orb bursts into {fragment_count} seeking fragments. Each deals {fragment_percent}% of its damage to a different enemy within {fragment_range} units. The original target is excluded; unused fragments fade.
heavy:grave_echo.name: Grave Echo

hex_lantern.description: Slow curse bolts deal negligible damage. Hexed enemies take {vulnerability_percent}% more tower damage for {mark_duration} seconds. Other towers in range gain {aura_damage_percent}% damage. Only the strongest hex and aura apply.
hex_lantern.name: Hex Lantern

hex_lantern:2.description: Slow curse bolts deal negligible damage. Hexed enemies take {vulnerability_percent}% more tower damage for {mark_duration} seconds. Other towers in range gain {aura_damage_percent}% damage. Only the strongest hex and aura apply.
hex_lantern:2.name: Hex Lantern

hex_lantern:3.description: Slow curse bolts deal negligible damage. Hexed enemies take {vulnerability_percent}% more tower damage for {mark_duration} seconds. Other towers in range gain {aura_damage_percent}% damage. Only the strongest hex and aura apply.
hex_lantern:3.name: Hex Lantern

hex_lantern:oathbrand.description: Concentrates on one enemy: +{vulnerability_percent}% incoming tower damage for {mark_duration} seconds. Other towers in range gain {aura_damage_percent}% damage. Only the strongest hex and aura apply; boss defenses remain intact.
hex_lantern:oathbrand.name: Oathbrand

hex_lantern:witchlight.description: Marks add {vulnerability_percent}% incoming damage. A directly marked death spreads the mark to {mark_spread_count} nearby enemies for {mark_duration} seconds. Spread marks never spread again. Other towers in range gain {aura_damage_percent}% damage. Only the strongest hex and aura apply.
hex_lantern:witchlight.name: Witchlight

ironspike.description: A straight bolt pierces up to {pierce_count} aligned enemies, losing damage after each hit. Best beside long straight roads.
ironspike.name: Ironspike

ironspike:2.description: A straight bolt pierces up to {pierce_count} aligned enemies, losing damage after each hit. Best beside long straight roads.
ironspike:2.name: Ironspike

ironspike:3.description: A straight bolt pierces up to {pierce_count} aligned enemies, losing damage after each hit. Best beside long straight roads.
ironspike:3.name: Ironspike

ironspike:needle_battery.description: Fires {volley_count} parallel bolts, each piercing {pierce_count} enemies. A victim takes at most one hit per volley; wider coverage trades away single-target force.
ironspike:needle_battery.name: Needle Battery

ironspike:siegebreaker.description: Heavy bolts pierce {pierce_count} enemies at full damage. Boss hits deal {boss_damage_multiplier} times damage before defenses. A slower reload rewards focus fire.
ironspike:siegebreaker.name: Siegebreaker

moonwheel.description: A crescent cuts out and back through up to {pierce_count} enemies per pass. Each enemy can take one hit on each leg; only one blade flies at a time.
moonwheel.name: Moonwheel

moonwheel:2.description: A crescent cuts out and back through up to {pierce_count} enemies per pass. Each enemy can take one hit on each leg; only one blade flies at a time.
moonwheel:2.name: Moonwheel

moonwheel:3.description: A crescent cuts out and back through up to {pierce_count} enemies per pass. Each enemy can take one hit on each leg; only one blade flies at a time.
moonwheel:3.name: Moonwheel

moonwheel:orbit_crown.description: Three blades orbit in a short radius, sweeping all nearby enemies every {period} seconds. Each enemy takes one hit per sweep, never one hit per blade.
moonwheel:orbit_crown.name: Orbit Crown

moonwheel:reaper_wheel.description: A giant serrated crescent cuts through {pierce_count} enemies on each leg. Its broad, long corridor and slower throws reward dense traffic.
moonwheel:reaper_wheel.name: Reaper Wheel

rapid.description: Swift pointed darts cut through hollows and wraiths.
rapid.name: Ashneedle

rapid:2.description: Swift pointed darts cut through hollows and wraiths.
rapid:2.name: Ashneedle

rapid:3.description: Swift pointed darts cut through hollows and wraiths.
rapid:3.name: Ashneedle

rapid:frostneedle.description: Ice needles slow enemies by {slow_percent}% for {slow_duration} seconds. Repeated hits refresh the slow; they never stack.
rapid:frostneedle.name: Frostneedle

rapid:thorn_volley.description: Arrows poison their target for {duration} seconds, dealing {poison_dps} damage each second. Hits from this tower refresh the poison without stacking.
rapid:thorn_volley.name: Poison Arrow

splash.description: Flame waves burst on impact, striking every enemy within the blast radius.
splash.name: Pyre

splash:2.description: Flame waves burst on impact, striking every enemy within the blast radius.
splash:2.name: Pyre

splash:3.description: Flame waves burst on impact, striking every enemy within the blast radius.
splash:3.name: Pyre

splash:cinderfield.description: Blasts leave burning ground for {burn_duration} seconds at {burn_dps} damage per second. Overlapping fire from this tower refreshes without stacking.
splash:cinderfield.name: Cinderfield

splash:rupture_pyre.description: Blasts deal {damage} damage every {period} seconds and push enemies back {push_distance} units, reduced by enemy resistance. Enemies resist another push for {push_immunity} seconds.
splash:rupture_pyre.name: Rupture Pyre

scope: Shipped defaults without player overrides, equipment, or temporary combat effects
